jobs.name: s6_ic_timer
jobs.prompt: icon of a stopwatch with a small friendly waving hand next to it, meaning a greeting that takes only two seconds

jobs.name: s6_first
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration, medium close shot. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind a pharmacy counter on the right, has just looked up and is greeting a customer who is just stepping up to the counter on the left (customer seen from the side, clearly visible, mouth closed — has not started talking yet). Their eyes meet, the pharmacist smiles warmly and speaks first. Both people large in frame. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
jobs.meaning: фармацевт первой поднимает взгляд и здоровается, раньше чем посетитель начал говорить

jobs.name: s6_window
jobs.prompt: A cold impersonal dispensing window: a small glass hatch in a grey wall, only an anonymous hand passing a medicine box through it, no face visible, a customer on the other side looking uneasy. Muted, slightly desaturated palette within the brand colors. NO signs, text or labels anywhere.

jobs.name: s6_specialist
jobs.prompt: The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) at an open pharmacy counter, leaning slightly toward a customer, attentive eye contact, friendly face-to-face conversation; the customer looks relieved. Warm light. NO signs, text or labels anywhere, shelves hold plain colored boxes.
jobs.meaning: живой специалист, разговор лицом к лицу

jobs.name: s6_ic_eyes
jobs.prompt: icon of two eyes looking straight ahead with a small spark, meaning eye contact

jobs.name: s6_ic_phrase
jobs.prompt: icon of a single short speech bubble with three dots inside

jobs.name: s6_ic_tone
jobs.prompt: icon of a smiling face next to a gentle soft sound wave, meaning a friendly warm tone of voice

jobs.name: s6_nod
jobs.prompt: Semi-flat illustration (NOT a photo). The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) stands behind the counter handing a box to a customer in front of her, while her head is clearly turned to the RIGHT toward a second person waiting in line a few steps behind; their eyes meet and the pharmacist gives a small friendly nod; the waiting person smiles back, relaxed. Both customers clearly visible. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
jobs.meaning: занята покупателем, но взглядом и кивком даёт понять следующему, что его заметили

jobs.name: s6_ic_habit
jobs.prompt: icon of a small green sprout growing out of a circular arrow loop, meaning a new daily habit forming. Absolutely no numbers, letters or text.

jobs.name: s6_ic_survey
jobs.prompt: icon of a clipboard with two short answer lines and a small heart, meaning a short feedback survey
jobs.meaning: пара вопросов в конце, ваше мнение важно
